counting_baseline: Q=(m,n,schema_certificate) only; insufficient for exact graph-PHP semantics
semantic_contract: F SAT iff recognized G_F has a matching saturating L; F UNSAT iff exists S subset L with |N(S)|<|S|

certificate_paths.SAT: saturating matching M -> assignment -> root CNF replay
certificate_paths.UNSAT: Hall witness (S,N(S)) -> neighborhood and strict deficiency verification

hard_family_schema: FPHP(G_n), |L|=n+1, |R|=n, left degree 3, (gamma*n,delta)-boundary expander for fixed gamma,delta>0

hardness_reference.source: Miksa-Nordstrom ECCC TR15-078 Theorem 4.9 + existence discussion; resolution-width transfer restated in ECCC TR19-052 Theorem 28
hardness_reference.claim: width > delta*s/(2d); for s=gamma*n,d=3 gives Omega(n)

finite_hard_fixture.role: executable smoke only; not itself the asymptotic Omega(n) claim

pass_scope: separation for one polynomially recognizable graph-PHP language containing both SAT and UNSAT instances
